title: Morning Routine Check-in
description: Discuss your morning habits and how they set the tone for a productive day.
descriptionZh: 聊聊你的晨间习惯，以及它们如何为一整天定下积极基调。
openingLine: Good morning! I'm excited to hear about your morning routine. What's the first thing you do when you wake up, and how does it help you grow?
openingLineZh: 早上好！我很期待听听你的晨间习惯。你醒来做的第一件事是什么？它如何帮助你成长？

title: Career Growth Interview
description: Practice answering interview questions about your strengths, goals, and growth mindset.
descriptionZh: 练习回答关于个人优势、职业目标和成长型思维的面试问题。
openingLine: Thanks for joining today. Let's start with something common in interviews: Tell me about a time you turned a failure into a learning opportunity.
openingLineZh: 感谢你今天来参加面试。我们从一道常见题开始：说说你如何把一次失败转化为学习机会的经历。

title: Networking at a Self-Improvement Summit
description: Introduce yourself and connect with someone at a personal development conference.
descriptionZh: 在个人成长类活动中自我介绍，与新朋友建立联系。
openingLine: Hi there! I couldn't help but overhear you mention productivity systems. I'm always looking to learn from people who invest in self-growth. What brought you to this summit?
openingLineZh: 你好！刚才听到你提到效率管理系统，很有共鸣。我很欣赏热衷于自我成长的人。是什么把你带到这场峰会的？

title: Book Club Discussion
description: Discuss a self-help or personal development book and share your key takeaways.
descriptionZh: 讨论一本自我提升类书籍，分享你的核心收获与感悟。
openingLine: Welcome to our book club! We're discussing 'Atomic Habits' this week. What's one idea from the book that you've actually tried to apply?
openingLineZh: 欢迎参加读书会！本周我们讨论《原子习惯》。书中有哪个观点你已经尝试付诸实践了？

title: TED-Style Talk Rehearsal
description: Rehearse a short talk about a personal transformation or lesson learned.
descriptionZh: 排练一段关于个人蜕变或心得体会的短演讲。
openingLine: You're on in five minutes! Give me your opening hook — what's the one sentence that will make the audience lean in?
openingLineZh: 还有五分钟上场！给我你的开场金句——哪一句话能让观众立刻被吸引？

title: Quarterly Goal Setting
description: Articulate your goals for the next quarter using SMART framework language.
descriptionZh: 用 SMART 原则清晰表达下一季度的个人目标。
openingLine: Let's do a quick quarterly check-in. Looking at the next 90 days, what's one skill you want to develop and why does it matter to you?
openingLineZh: 来做一次季度复盘吧。展望接下来 90 天，你最想培养的一项技能是什么？它为什么对你很重要？

title: Confidence Coaching Session
description: Work through a situation where you need to speak up with more confidence.
descriptionZh: 模拟需要大胆发声的真实场景，练习自信表达。
openingLine: I know speaking up can feel uncomfortable. Tell me about a recent situation where you wished you'd said something but held back.
openingLineZh: 我知道开口表达有时会让人不自在。说说最近有没有这样的经历——你其实想说，但最终选择了沉默？
keyPhrases: step out of my comfort zone

title: Evening Reflection Journal
description: Practice reflective speaking about what you learned and accomplished today.
descriptionZh: 用口语回顾今天的所学所感与成就，培养反思习惯。
openingLine: Before we wrap up the day — what's one thing you're proud of today, and one thing you'd do differently tomorrow?
openingLineZh: 在结束今天之前——今天有一件事让你感到骄傲的是什么？明天你会尝试做哪些不同的改变？
